key_path: Platform partners: contact Wise sales -> partner onboarding -> Wise issues sandbox client_id/secret and grants Developer Hub access (wise-sandbox.com/developer-hub)
SMB path: open a Wise Business account (full KYC/KYB) -> Settings > API tokens -> create personal token -> complete 2-step verification
personal tokens only cover quotes, recipients, transfers, statuses; production funding needs SCA

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no - no official MCP; mcp.wise.com returns 530
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no - client credentials issued by Wise; Developer Hub can rotate/revoke
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: partial - personal tokens are limited to a subset of endpoints; partner credentials scoped by integration model
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - Sandbox V2 at wise-sandbox.com, but partner credentials come from Wise
agent_native_auth.free_tier: no API free tier as such

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - .md pages including versioned API reference (api-reference/2026q3/*.md)
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - generated OpenAPI per version under docs.wise.com/api-reference

time_to_first_call_minutes.note: personal token needs a verified business account (days); partner sandbox needs sales onboarding (days-weeks)

score_justification: Good machine-readable docs, but every credential path goes through KYC or a sales/implementation team and there is no official MCP.
best_practice: Versioned API reference as Markdown (2026q3 / preview / legacy) so agents can pin to the right API version.
biggest_gap: No self-serve sandbox credentials and no MCP.
notes_out_of_date: Sandbox V1 (sandbox.transferwise.tech) was deprecated on 2026-06-30; older tutorials pointing there are stale. Personal-token docs also link a migration guide to OAuth+mTLS.
